name: go_wani_end
desc: the little cat has been completely pulled inside the crocodile goo chest: remove the cat, the chest and belly of the goo crocodile now bulge out round and lumpy with the shape of the small cat pressed inside, only the tip of its purple witch hat sticks out of the goo, goo closing over it and dripping. The crocodile keeps the same pose, arms spread, toothy grin, same colors and pixel art style.
